reasoning_summary: Reused the persisted cleaned book table and initial volume-demand pool. Computed the exposure-aware quality value from Goodreads ratings_count p60 shrinkage toward the ratings-count-weighted mean, percentile-ranked it on the cleaned table, rebuilt the same active review pool with volume demand and ratings-count filters, then compared initial top-10 membership against the exposure-aware top-10. Flip strength was computed as abs(demand percentile gap + quality percentile gap), with demand gap equal to zero because demand treatment did not change.
